name: io.github.ainative-studio/ainative-gtm-mcp
description: Full Google Ads + Analytics + Tag Manager lifecycle for AI agents: create Search/Display/Performance Max campaigns, swap bidding strategies, control bids, add ad extensions, import offline conversions, and manage GTM containers. 57 tools.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google Ads API developer token (required for Google Ads tools)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Google Ads customer ID (10 digits, no dashes)

environmentVariables.name: GTM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Google Cloud service-account JSON key with Tag Manager API access
